build_custom_logger_registry: build a CustomLoggerRegistry instance to map callback string names to their class types
create_callback_lookup: create a lookup that maps callback string names like 'datadog' to their logger class types
get_callback_str_from_class_type: get the callback string from a given logger class type using CustomLoggerRegistry.get_callback_str_from_class_type
get_all_callback_strs_from_class_type: get all callback strings that map to the same class type, such as OpenTelemetry aliases
get_class_type_for_custom_logger_name: get the logger class type for a given custom logger name from the registry
